TALLA BRIDAL

Imperial burgundy velvet and antique gold zardozi — heritage palace campaign and 4K cinema suite.

CLIENT Talla Couture
DISCIPLINE Haute Couture · 4K Cinema & Stills
PACKAGE Imperial Bridal Suite (Full Production)
YEAR 2026

Imperial Velvet & Antique Zardozi.

Anchored in deep royal burgundy velvet and illuminated by hand-couched antique gold zardozi embroidery, this campaign captures the regal poise of classical Indian bridal couture. Set within historic palace colonnades and sunlit jharokhas, each frame balances monumental architectural scale with intimate textile intricacy.

Engineered as an integrated premium campaign package, the suite encompasses a 4K vertical cinema master tailored for high-impact social and digital flagships, alongside ultra-high-resolution panoramic and macro archival plates built for billboards, luxury lookbooks, and editorial features.
